initialization: five manually verified detections; explicitly report seeded tracking, not automatic acquisition
label_policy: Review raw footage before predictions. Record only visible ball centres; mark occlusion/uncertainty. Do not interpolate truth. Label release/bounce as frame intervals when visible. Never supply later labels to tracker.
evaluation: Keep current parameters fixed. Compare detector-only and guided tracker on same labelled frames. Report correct, wrong, missed, precision, recall, pixel error and per-clip results; include all supplied eligible clips. Report training-overlap uncertainty. Event timings assessed separately; no metric distances without suitable reference.
tuning: Any subsequent tuning invalidates held-out status for these clips; retain a further untouched set.
